research_summary: The Netherlands CRM market is valued at US$1.83bn projected for 2029 with 8.51% growth (2025-2029). Five providers (Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics, Pipedrive, Exact CRM, Teamleader) cover 84% of the market. Average spend per employee is projected at US$128.40 in 2025.
market_observations: Top 5 control 84% market share. Local providers (AFAS, Exact, Teamleader) dominate SME segment with Dutch business practice understanding. International platforms (Salesforce, Microsoft) serve multinationals. Strong GDPR compliance focus.
